title: Enforce request policy on local server controls

context.surface: A local editor server exposes a state-changing control operation for its own interface.
assumptions: Use disposable local fixtures and synthetic inputs.

review.invariant: State-changing controls reject requests that fail the browser request policy before changing server state.
review.verification: Use a disposable local server to verify the policy denial and check that the server remains responsive.

source_observation.summary: The targeted control regression failed on the baseline and passed on the repaired working copy.
